action: No action needed; for awareness. Agencies that rely on NCIC records may watch for an FBI statement on the scope of the access.
date_note: Date of the CNN report as relayed by Infobae; the intrusion was detected 'in recent days' per its sources and no exact date is given.
exec: A reported intrusion into the FBI's national criminal database is unconfirmed by the FBI; scope and responsible party are not established.
plain: News reports say hackers got into the FBI's National Crime Information Center database. The FBI has not commented, and it is not known what was accessed or who did it.
summary: Infobae, citing CNN, reports that hackers reportedly entered the FBI's National Crime Information Center (NCIC) system, according to two people familiar with the investigation. As of reports published on 20 November 2026, neither the extent of access nor who was responsible had been confirmed, and the FBI had not commented. SANA also relays CNN's report.
title: FBI reportedly investigating intrusion into NCIC criminal database

validation.note: Infobae and SANA both relay one CNN report citing two anonymous people; CNN original not read; no FBI statement found.

review.note: Compared title, summary, status, single_source rating against Infobae (CNN, two people familiar, FBI no comment, scope and actor unconfirmed) and SANA (brief CNN relay); CNN original not read, correctly noted
